(3) The scene shifts to an indoor setting where a young man with messy black hair wearing a grey sweatshirt and a black face mask is sitting. (5) Back in the room, the man puts on a light blue surgical mask over his black mask. He holds the document close to his face, his eyes appearing wide and focused. (6) The man continues to talk to the camera, gesturing frequently with his hands to emphasize his points. He rubs his hair and places his hands on his head, expressing frustration. (7) In the final phase, the man is seen in a wider shot of a living room with bright indoor lighting. He begins to jump and flap his arms wildly like a butterfly, acting out a silly persona while still wearing his masks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the neutral, low-arousal voice of a man (likely a police officer) asking for a signature, accompanied by the distinct rustling sound of paper being handled. There is no BGM at this very start. (2) A sharp transition occurs as high-tempo, major-mode electronic music with a strong beat (approx. 128 BPM) swells in. The main speaker's voice becomes high-pitched and high-arousal, shouting in a comedic, distressed tone about a military call-up. (3) A brief 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition to a musical snippet with rhythmic rap-style vocals in Mandarin, layered over synth textures. (4) The main speaker returns with rapid-fire speech, expressing panic. Multiple 'pop' and 'cartoon' sound effects punctuate his sentences as he describes the 14-day duration and the hot summer weather. (5) In the final phase, the BGM continues with a bouncy rhythm as the speaker's voice shifts to an exaggeratedly silly and playful tone, singing a simple melody about being a 'little butterfly' with high pitch variability.
